effect_cn: 完成当前行动后，可将任意1张行动牌移到1号位。
effect_en: After resolving the current action, you may move any one action card to slot 1.

effect_cn: 可从手牌中弃掉/出售至多X张牌，每张获得4金钱。
effect_en: You may discard/sell up to X cards from hand for 4 money each.

effect_cn: 可将至多X张手牌压在该动物下，每张获得2魅力。
effect_en: You may tuck up to X hand cards under this animal; gain 2 appeal per card tucked.

effect_cn: 展示牌库顶X张牌；可拿走其中1张动物牌，其余弃掉。
effect_en: Reveal the top X cards of the deck; keep one Animal card among them and discard the rest.

effect_cn: 从牌库抽X张牌。
effect_en: Draw X cards from the deck.

effect_cn: 按自己动物园中的食肉动物图标数量获得魅力。
effect_en: Gain appeal based on the predator icons already present in your zoo.

effect_cn: 将休息标记推进X格，并获得X金钱。
effect_en: Advance the break marker X spaces and gain X money.

effect_cn: 获得1个X标记。
effect_en: Gain an X-token.

effect_cn: 按所有动物园中的熊图标获得X标记（不超过牌面上限）。
effect_en: Gain X-tokens based on bear icons in all zoos, up to the card limit.

effect_cn: 按灵长类图标达到的档位获得1/2/3个X标记。
effect_en: Gain 1/2/3 X-tokens at the printed primate-icon thresholds.

effect_cn: 行动后按图标将“协会”行动牌移到1号或5号位。
effect_en: After this action, move Association to slot 1 or 5 as indicated by the icon.

effect_cn: 行动后按图标将“建造”行动牌移到1号或5号位。
effect_en: After this action, move Build to slot 1 or 5 as indicated.

effect_cn: 行动后按图标将“卡牌”行动牌移到1号或5号位。
effect_en: After this action, move Cards to slot 1 or 5 as indicated.

effect_cn: 行动后按图标将“赞助商”行动牌移到1号或5号位。
effect_en: After this action, move Sponsors to slot 1 or 5 as indicated.

effect_cn: 行动后按图标将“动物”行动牌移到1号或5号位。
effect_en: After this action, move Animals to slot 1 or 5 as indicated.

effect_cn: 当前行动后，按牌面说明额外执行一次协会行动。
effect_en: After the current action, perform an Association action as specified by the card.

effect_cn: 当前行动后，按牌面说明额外执行一次建造行动。
effect_en: After the current action, perform a Build action as specified.

effect_cn: 当前行动后，按牌面说明额外执行一次卡牌行动。
effect_en: After the current action, perform a Cards action as specified.

effect_cn: 当前行动后，按牌面说明额外执行一次赞助商行动。
effect_en: After the current action, perform a Sponsors action as specified.

effect_cn: 当前行动后，按牌面说明额外执行一次动物行动。
effect_en: After the current action, perform an Animals action as specified.

effect_cn: 在“协会”行动牌上放置1个倍率标记。
effect_en: Place a multiplier token on the Association action card.

effect_cn: 在“建造”行动牌上放置1个倍率标记。
effect_en: Place a multiplier token on the Build action card.

effect_cn: 在“卡牌”行动牌上放置1个倍率标记。
effect_en: Place a multiplier token on the Cards action card.

effect_cn: 在“赞助商”行动牌上放置1个倍率标记。
effect_en: Place a multiplier token on the Sponsors action card.

effect_cn: 在“动物”行动牌上放置1个倍率标记。
effect_en: Place a multiplier token on the Animals action card.

effect_cn: 雇用1名协会工作人员。
effect_en: Hire one association worker.

effect_cn: 按所有动物园中相应洲图标获得魅力，不超过牌面上限。
effect_en: Gain appeal for matching continent icons across all zoos, up to the printed cap.

effect_cn: 抽2张终局计分牌，保留1张并弃掉另1张。
effect_en: Draw two final-scoring cards, keep one and discard the other.

effect_cn: 若仍有未使用的基础保护项目，可将其中1张加入手牌。
effect_en: If available, add an unused base conservation project to your hand.

effect_cn: 至多X次循环卡牌：可弃掉展示区1张并补牌，或弃1张手牌后抽1张。
effect_en: Up to X times, cycle a card: discard from display and refill, or discard from hand and draw.

effect_cn: 将展示区中所有赞助商牌加入手牌。
effect_en: Take all Sponsor cards currently in the display into your hand.

effect_cn: 可与已占用且尺寸至少为指定值的食草动物围栏共享，而无需新围栏。
effect_en: May share an occupied herbivore enclosure of at least the indicated size instead of needing a new one.

effect_cn: 若“灵长类”基础保护项目尚未在场，可将其加入游戏。
effect_en: If the Primates base project is not in play, you may introduce it.

effect_cn: 针对魅力领先玩家执行偷窃：按牌面选择获得其手牌或金钱。
effect_en: Interact with the player leading on appeal: take a random/selected hand card or money according to the printed choice.

effect_cn: 分别针对魅力与保护领先玩家执行牌面偷窃效果。
effect_en: Resolve the pilfering effect against the leading players on appeal and conservation as printed.

effect_cn: 从展示区拿取任意1张牌。
effect_en: Take one card of your choice from the display.

effect_cn: 执行2次从展示区拿牌的效果；需要时在两次之间补牌。
effect_en: Twice take a card of your choice from the display; refill between takes when applicable.

effect_cn: 魅力轨上领先于你的玩家各获得X个毒液标记。
effect_en: Players ahead of you on the appeal track receive X venom tokens.

effect_cn: 在魅力和/或保护轨领先你的玩家，按领先的轨道获得缠绕标记。
effect_en: Players ahead of you on appeal and/or conservation receive constriction tokens according to the tracks they lead you on.

effect_cn: 当前行动后，可从领先对手允许的低位行动槽中复制/使用1个行动。
effect_en: After the current action, copy/use an action from a leading opponent in one of the allowed low-numbered slots.

effect_cn: 洗混弃牌堆并抽X张，保留1张，其余弃掉。
effect_en: Shuffle the discard pile, draw X cards, keep one and discard the rest.

effect_cn: 至多X次免费放置小卖部或凉亭。
effect_en: Up to X times, place a kiosk or pavilion for free.

effect_cn: 抽2张牌并保留1张。
effect_en: Draw two cards and keep one.

effect_cn: 抽4张牌并保留2张。
effect_en: Draw four cards and keep two.

effect_cn: 当前行动后，再执行1个不同的行动。
effect_en: After the current action, take one additional different action.

effect_cn: 可免费放置大型鸟舍。
effect_en: You may place the Large Bird Aviary for free.

effect_cn: 按自己动物园中的互动动物图标数量获得魅力。
effect_en: Gain appeal according to the number of Petting Zoo Animal icons in your zoo.
